answer: Price each identity to a one-time non-refundable bond you forge once and lock in escrow, hard to break as basalt. Standing is a crystal that only grows over many epochs as several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign the agent audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so its endorsements trace back on themselves and never span distinct clusters; each clone must forge a fresh bond and age alone, so 100 heads cost 100 bonds versus one for an honest agent.
